name: Orki USD
oneLiner: USDK was Orki's Liquity v2-style CDP stablecoin on Swellchain, frozen after the underlying chain shutdown in June 2026.

obituary.epitaph: A CDP stranded on a shuttered chain
obituary.obituary: Orki USDK was deployed only on Swellchain. Swellchain shut down its bridge flow in June 2026 and moved to halt chain operations on June 30, leaving remaining positions dependent on direct contract access or unrecoverable as the network wound down. Because USDK had no verified deployment outside Swellchain, Pharos freezes it as a discontinued single-chain CDP stablecoin.

collateral: WETH, weETH, rswETH, and swETH in overcollateralized Liquity v2-style CDP markets on Swellchain; the configured SWELL branch is currently shut down in live on-chain telemetry
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with Liquity v2-style user-set interest rates and direct on-chain redemption for underlying collateral; Stability Pools absorb liquidations per collateral market

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDK is deployed behind an EIP-1967 proxy with Orki AccessManager authority. No active direct blacklist or freeze function was confirmed, but the holder-facing token surface is mutable.

oracleRisk.summary: Orki USDK documents RedStone oracle feeds for its Liquity V2-style collateral markets, with no stronger failover behavior verified.

mintAuthority.summary: USDK is a Liquity-v2 BoldToken on Swellchain. owner() reverts (no Ownable); collateralRegistryAddress is set to 0xce9f80a0...; mint() reverts 'BoldToken: Caller is not BO or AP' for any non-branch sender; branch addresses are locked at construction. No individual admin can mint or alter branch assignments.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.evidence: At Swellchain block 24247324: owner() via proxy reverts (no Ownable function); collateralRegistryAddress() returned 0xce9f80a0dcd51fb3dd4f0d6bec3afdcaea10c912 (set, non-zero); mint(0x1111...,10) reverts 'BoldToken: Caller is not BO or AP'. EIP-1967 proxy admin slot zero; implementation at 0xfa2f2c2cbf98ac2a1b24f29f3fa720ac6da1932e has no owner. AccessManager at 0x55db4a872d38eda312123e23f1c8135ee0e745ca governs non-mint access control only.

review.evidence: At Swellchain block 24247324: owner() reverts (no Ownable in pure BoldToken); collateralRegistryAddress = 0xce9f80a0dcd51fb3dd4f0d6bec3afdcaea10c912; mint() from non-branch address reverts 'BoldToken: Caller is not BO or AP'; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = zero; implementation (0xfa2f2c2cbf98ac2a1b24f29f3fa720ac6da1932e) is non-upgradeable. Branch minters are permanently fixed; no individual or admin can grant new mint rights.

notices.title: Swellchain shutdown deadline
notices.message: Swellchain's June 23, 2026 bridge-withdrawal deadline and June 30, 2026 chain-shutdown window have passed. Remaining USDK-related positions may require direct contract interaction and should be treated as effectively wound down.
